title: Going to the Mela
seo_title: Going to the Mela Class 3 EVS Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 2)
standard_code: Class 3, Our Wondrous World Chapter 2: Going to the Mela
standard_text: A visit to a mela (fair): sights, sounds, crafts and artisans; buying and selling with money; staying safe in a crowd; famous melas of India (summary of NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 2).
meta_desc: Free CBSE Class 3 EVS worksheets for NCERT Our Wondrous World Chapter 2: sights and crafts at a mela, artisans, counting money and change, safety in crowds and famous melas of India. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: A mela is a fair full of crafts, food and fun.
key_sub: Count your money and stay close to adults.
body_html:
How to think about it

A mela is a fair where people come together to buy, sell, play and celebrate. Potters, weavers, toy makers and bangle sellers bring things they make by hand, and there are rides like the giant wheel and puppet shows.

We use coins and notes to pay and count the change carefully. In a crowd, hold an adult's hand, remember a parent's phone number and ask a police officer or the help desk if you are lost. Famous melas include the Kumbh Mela, the Pushkar camel fair and the Surajkund crafts mela.

Example

₹50 − ₹15?

take away the cost

Answer: ₹35 left

Example

Lost at a mela?

stay in one place

Answer: ask the help desk or a police officer

Common mistakes

  • Going home alone when lost.
  • Adding when you should subtract the change.
  • Throwing litter at the mela.

faq.q: What should you do if you get lost at a mela?
faq.a: Stay where you are and ask a police officer or the help desk for help.

items.q: Who sells or makes woven cloth and mats at a mela?
items.e: A weaver: woven cloth and mats.

items.q: Why do people bargain at a mela?

items.e: Bargaining is common at local markets.

items.q: Who sells or makes iron tools such as sickles at a mela?

items.q: Which coin is the smallest value used today in India?
items.e: There are ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10 and ₹20 coins.

items.q: Which crafts fair is held every year at Surajkund in Haryana?

items.q: Who sells or makes colourful glass bangles at a mela?

items.q: Why should we buy handmade things from artisans?

items.q: Why are melas good for artisans?

items.q: Who sells or makes fresh sugarcane juice at a mela?

items.q: Why should children hold an adult's hand in a crowded mela?

items.e: Remember a parent's phone number too.

items.q: Who sells or makes clay pots and toys at a mela?

items.q: Why should we not throw litter at a mela?

items.e: Use dustbins.
